Guide · ready in 3 minutes

How Arnold works.

Arnold plans a short workout and simple food for you every day – matched to your goal, your age, your fitness and your taste. Here are six steps to get started, followed by everything Arnold can do.

Open Arnold →⤓ As PDF

Test version: all plans and calories are guidelines and are no substitute for medical advice. If you’re 50+ or have health conditions, please get a medical check-up first.

First steps

From opening the app to your first completed workout.

Step 1

Get started

The start page shows what Arnold can do. Choose your language at the top right. Get started → takes you to your profile. Tap the logo any time to come back here.

Step 2

Set up training

First: should Arnold plan training and food, training only or food only? Then goals, age, height, weight and how fit you are right now. For each sport you can tap fixed days – otherwise Arnold spreads them out for you.

Step 3

Set up food

In the Food tab you choose your meals, whether you want to batch cook, your diet and allergies. For ingredients, tap once for I like it and twice for I don’t – Arnold plans accordingly.

Step 4

Your daily plan

Today shows everything for the day: your workout, your meals with calories and the week as a strip. From now on Arnold always opens right here.

Step 5

Tick off your workout

Every exercise has instructions under How to, with typical mistakes and the right breathing. Enter what you managed and tap Done.

Step 6

Say how it went

After your workout Arnold asks: Too easy, Just right or Too hard? From tomorrow the exercises get harder or easier. That way the plan grows with you.

After installing

Put it on your device once and Arnold works without internet too.

  1. InstalliPhone and iPad: in Safari “Share” → “Add to Home Screen”. Android: in Chrome menu ⋮ → “Install app”. PC and Mac: in Chrome or Edge, the install icon in the address bar.
  2. Use offlineOnce installed, Arnold works without internet – in the basement gym as well as in a dead zone.
  3. Back up your dataYour data is only stored on your device. Under ⚙ → Backup you can download a backup and restore it on a new device. On a PC this can also run automatically.
  4. UpdatesWhen there’s a new version, Arnold shows you what’s new first. You decide when to update.
  5. Language and colourSwitch the language at the top right, the colour under ⚙.

Everything Arnold can do

You’ll find all areas in the bar at the top.

My calendar

The whole week at a glance: which days you train, what’s for dinner and when you cook. Use the arrows to move to next week.

Exercises

Over a hundred exercises with instructions, sorted by theme (legs, back, core …) and type: strength, endurance, mobility. First only your sports – tap All to see the rest.

Food and batch cooking

Over 365 dishes from many cuisines – something different every day for a year. Arnold fits the portions to your needs, and you can scale them with + and −. Nutrition and allergens are shown.

Shopping list

The shopping list for the whole week builds itself from your plan, sorted by supermarket aisle. Tick off, copy or print – and use the arrows to flip to next week.

Drinks

What’s in cola, juice, beer and wine? All drinks sorted by calories per 100 ml – so you can see where the calories hide.

Progress

Your weight as a curve and every exercise you’ve done with your latest and best result. Weighing once a week is enough.

Settings

Under ⚙ you choose the colour, back up your data and see your version.

On your phone

Same content, made for thumbs: the bar sits at the top as big buttons.

Little tips

  • Skipped a day? Tap Not today – tomorrow simply carries on.
  • Batch cooking saves the most time: on cooking day the daily plan shows “Cook today: for 3 days”.
  • Not in the mood for exercise? Switch to Food only under My area → My goals. Or the other way round.
  • From 50, Arnold automatically plans joint-friendly exercises and more mobility.
  • Always weigh yourself at the same time, in the morning after getting up. Fluctuations are normal.
  • All figures are guidelines and do not replace medical advice.

Good luck!

Start small, keep going, setbacks are part of it. Got an idea or found a bug? We’re happy to hear from you.
